chitchat: tracks a distant contact through the optics and mutters a range to nobody.
"Anything with wings over the vats is a target. Company policy."
description: A Coldwater security gunner in vats-white armour, strapped into the Guardian battery's seat with her eyes on the sky. The clone tanks glow behind her; nothing gets to hit them on her watch.

bye.text: They turn back to the guns and the sky.

root.text: They keep one eye on the sky. "Unless you're here to help work the guns, you're in the way. Move."

name: a Guardian battery gunner
